    About Dental Oasis

    A family dental practice built around comfort, clear communication and long-term oral health.

    Our story

    Dental Oasis began with a simple idea: a dental visit should feel calm, not stressful. Over four and a half years we have grown from a single chair to a full clinic with digital X-rays, 3D scanning and a dedicated children’s room.

    Every treatment plan is explained in plain language, priced up front and tailored to your goals.

    Patient Information

    Everything to know before, during and after your visit.

    Your first visit

    • Arrive 10 minutes early to complete a short form
    • Bring previous X-rays or reports, if any
    • List your medicines and allergies
    • Ask anything – no question is too small
    • Leave with a clear treatment plan and cost estimate

    Payments

    Cash, cards, UPI and most insurance. Ask about EMI for larger treatments.

    Frequently Asked Questions About Appointments

    Do I need an appointment or do you accept walk-ins?

    We welcome walk-ins; however, booking an appointment in advance guarantees zero waiting time and ensures dedicated time with Dr. Nilofar Pathan.

    Is dedicated parking available at the clinic?

    Yes, Vimal Complex has dedicated, convenient ground-floor parking space for both cars and two-wheelers right in front of the clinic entrance.

    What payment methods do you accept?

    We accept all UPI apps (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), credit and debit cards, cash, and bank transfers. Flexible EMI options are available for major treatments.

    What should I do in case of an acute dental emergency?

    Call or WhatsApp us immediately at +91 82082 62047. We prioritize severe tooth pain, swelling, and trauma with same-day emergency relief.
